note: BH-7430. The most bytes one pull-path spawn puts in its --file-local seed (job.json, the relays, the deploy snapshot, the model routes, plus 8 KB for the env lines and tokens). Fly stores the seed in the machine config, so a big seed is a big config. Over the cap, that spawn takes the push path and logs `<key>: push path (seed too big: ...)`. Per-project row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.seed_max_bytes`.
